paragraphs: I’m Onur, an AI engineer at Future Is Now. I build AI applications that connect retrieval, orchestration and real product experiences, mostly in Python, Java and TypeScript.

I graduated in software engineering from İzmir University of Economics in June 2026 and co-authored a water-safety paper accepted by IJEA. I care about the decisions behind a system: how it handles uncertainty, how it is evaluated and how people actually use it.
Away from the keyboard, I’m usually on a basketball or tennis court.
